title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{aligned} &1 - 2 - 3 + 4 + 5 - 6 - 7 \\ &\quad {}+ 8 + 9 - 10 - 11 + 12 \\ &\quad {}+ 13 - \cdots + 1992 \\ &\quad {}+ 1993 - 1994 \\ &\quad {}- 1995 + 1996 \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Grouping in blocks of four gives \(1 - 2 - 3 + 4 = 0,\) \(5 - 6 - 7 + 8 = 0,\) and so on.

There are \(\frac{1996}{4} = 499\) such blocks, each equal to \(0,\) so the total is \(0.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Group the terms in blocks of four starting from the first: \((1 - 2 - 3 + 4),\) \((5 - 6 - 7 + 8),\) and so on
Each block of four sums to \(0;\) check that the \(1996\) terms divide evenly into such blocks
